_comment: Citations for the Emperor's Children faction mechanics in code/simulator.py. Source: BSData v10.6.0 Chaos - Emperor's Children.cat.gz.

simulator.ec_daemonette_fights_first.quoted_text: <infoLink name="Fights First" id="fc22-54df-e539-41d9" hidden="false" type="rule" targetId="24-c886-e8ba-5a89"/>
simulator.ec_daemonette_fights_first.trigger: BSData selectionEntry id 06f6-b870-4e43-4ed9 (Daemonettes, Emperor's Children) carries the Fights First infoLink (id fc22-54df-e539-41d9) with hidden=false and NO condition/modifier — Daemonettes have Fights First unconditionally. CORRECTION (audit wave 2): the earlier version of this citation claimed the ability was detachment-gated via Carnival of Excess. That was a misread — the hidden=true modifier carrying the Carnival conditions (childId cac3-71d1-ea4b-795d / 3c9e-2156-254e-66e8) belongs to the SIBLING Fiends selectionEntry (id c2ca-f754-cc05-0743), and even there it governs unit AVAILABILITY, not the Fights First ability. So the mapper's extract_fights_first() producing fights_first=True is FAITHFUL, not an over-extraction.
simulator.ec_daemonette_fights_first.effect: No code change needed — Daemonettes correctly fight in the Fights First step (priority 0) by default. SWEG_EC_DAEMONETTE_FF (default-off) is a DO-NOT-ADOPT gate: enabling it would demote Daemonettes to the Remaining Combats step, REMOVING a real datasheet ability. Kept off (byte-identical to base) and retained only as documentation of the corrected finding.

COTERIE_OF_THE_CONCEITED.coterie_pact_po.rule_name: Slaanesh's Due (Coterie of the Conceited detachment rule)
COTERIE_OF_THE_CONCEITED.coterie_pact_po.quoted_text: At the start of the battle round, if your WARLORD is on the battlefield, you must pledge a number to Slaanesh representing how many enemy units will be destroyed this battle round. At the end of the battle round, if the number of enemy units destroyed this battle round is greater than or equal to your pledge, you gain a number of Pact points equal to your pledge. Otherwise, you do not gain any Pact points this battle round and your WARLORD model suffers D3 mortal wounds. EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units from your army gain a bonus depending on how many Pact points you have gained during the battle, as shown below (these are all cumulative). 1+: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. 3+: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. 5+: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [Lethal Hits] and [Sustained Hits 1] abilities. 7+: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.
COTERIE_OF_THE_CONCEITED.coterie_pact_po.trigger: The attacker is an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model whose army's resolved detachment is Coterie of the Conceited (gated SWEG_EC_DETACHMENT, default OFF). The four bonuses activate cumulatively once the army's running Pact-point total (tracked by the simulator across the battle) reaches 1 / 3 / 5 / 7.
COTERIE_OF_THE_CONCEITED.coterie_pact_po.effect: Cumulative army-wide attack bonuses keyed to the Pact-point total: 1+ re-roll a Hit roll of 1 (att_reroll_hit_ones); 3+ re-roll a Wound roll of 1 (att_reroll_wound_ones); 5+ melee weapons gain [Lethal Hits] and [Sustained Hits 1] (effective_lethal_hits + effective_sustained_hits, melee only); 7+ a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ (melee and ranged crit-to-hit threshold lowered to 5). The detachment flag is the entry point; the running Pact total and the pledge economy are resolved by the Battle hook cited as simulator.ec_coterie_pact_points.

simulator.ec_coterie_pact_points.rule_name: Slaanesh's Due — Pact-point pledge economy (simulator hook)
simulator.ec_coterie_pact_points.quoted_text: At the start of the battle round, if your WARLORD is on the battlefield, you must pledge a number to Slaanesh representing how many enemy units will be destroyed this battle round. At the end of the battle round, if the number of enemy units destroyed this battle round is greater than or equal to your pledge, you gain a number of Pact points equal to your pledge. Otherwise, you do not gain any Pact points this battle round and your WARLORD model suffers D3 mortal wounds.
simulator.ec_coterie_pact_points.trigger: End of each battle round for a Coterie of the Conceited army whose Warlord is still alive on the battlefield: the number of enemy units destroyed this round (Battle._units_destroyed_this_round, the same round-start-snapshot diff Purge the Foe and the Pariah Nexus secondaries use) is added to the army's running Pact-point total.
simulator.ec_coterie_pact_points.effect: APPROXIMATION. The player-chosen pledge is idealised as competent play: a strong pilot reads the board at the start of their turn, pledges up to the units they will reliably destroy this round, and meets it, banking Pact points equal to that pledge. SwegHammer collapses this to gaining one Pact point per enemy unit destroyed this round (the accrual a met, realised-output pledge yields), gated on the Warlord being alive on the battlefield (the rule's 'if your WARLORD is on the battlefield'). Counter is uncapped; the attack bonuses cap at the 7+ tier. HONEST OMISSIONS: the pledge is idealised as always met, so the D3-mortal-wounds-on-a-missed-pledge downside is not fired (a competent pilot pledges conservatively, down to 0, to avoid it); modelling frequent self-inflicted Warlord damage would model incompetent play. Any once-per-battle enhancement/stratagem interactions are not modelled. Off path (SWEG_EC_DETACHMENT='0') draws no RNG and is byte-identical.

simulator.ec_ranged_hold.rule_name: Advancing (10e Core Rules) + [ASSAULT] weapon ability — Emperor's Children gunline piloting heuristic
simulator.ec_ranged_hold.quoted_text: A unit that Advances can't shoot or declare a charge later this turn. ... [ASSAULT]: If a unit made a Normal move, Advanced or Fell Back this turn, its models can still make ranged attacks with weapons they are equipped with that have the [ASSAULT] ability when this unit is selected to shoot.
simulator.ec_ranged_hold.trigger: SWEG_EC_RANGED_HOLD default-OFF screening gate ('1' opt-in; unset/'0' is the byte-identical off path); a moving Emperor's Children unit seeking an objective (CAPTURE/STEAL intent), carrying no [ASSAULT] weapon, with ranged damage per activation >= 2.0 and weapon range >= 18 inches, that has a damageable target within a Normal move's reach.
simulator.ec_ranged_hold.effect: ARTIFICIAL-INTELLIGENCE PILOTING HEURISTIC — not a 10e rules claim; grounds in the core-rules fact that Advancing forfeits non-[ASSAULT] shooting. The SAME logic as simulator.am_advance_discipline / simulator.ck_ranged_hold / simulator.votann_ranged_hold / simulator.tsons_ranged_hold / simulator.soror_ranged_hold / simulator.tyranids_ranged_hold (an eighth entry point _ad_ec on the shared _suppress_advance block in code/simulator.py _do_move), restricted to Emperor's Children under the SWEG_EC_REALISM archetype (3x Lord Exultant, 2x Noise Marines, 2x Defiler). Derived from watched pilot-observation (2026-07-03, three piloted games: Chaos Knights seed 0, Orks seed 1, Necrons seed 2): the Noise Marines line (rDPA 4.66, range 18 inches) Advanced round 1 and, in two of the three games, round 2 as well, never firing a shot either round; the Sorcerer (5.34 / 18) and the Tormentors troop choice (2.27 / 24, itself capable of a Normal-move-shoot-then-charge sequence) showed the same pattern. The rDPA >= 2.0 & range >= 18 inch filter holds Noise Marines, Sorcerer, Tormentors and the Chaos Rhino transport (2.67 / 48); it does NOT hold the Defiler, the games' most dramatic misplay (Advanced rounds 1-2 in all three games before ever firing, then dealt 16-29 damage once held) — the Defiler's top-level `range_inches` reflects the mapper's best-single-expected-value weapon pick (Heavy baleflamer, a 12-inch torrent flamer), while its dominant ranged output sits on its SECONDARY profile (Hades battle cannon, 48 inches, rDPA approximately 12.0) and in extra_ranged_profiles (Ectoplasma destructor / Hades lascannon / Heavy reaper autocannon, all 36-48 inches) — fields this shared filter does not read. That gap is a known, reported limitation (see docs/DECISION_LEDGER.md), not fixed by this gate; a Defiler-reaching fix would need either a secondary-profile-aware reach check or a data-correctness re-pin of its primary weapon (the precedent is the wave-95 Knight Tyrant range_inches override and the already-adopted world_eaters_defiler ATK-BIAS-1 weapon pin in data/overrides.json, which the Emperor's Children and Chaos Space Marines Defiler catalog entries do not share). Off path (SWEG_EC_RANGED_HOLD='0') byte-identical to the pre-change baseline.
